payload.name: Creator Resource Vault V1
payload.description:
Build a Creator Resource Vault feature for RobinOS V1.

GOAL: Increase perceived value of RobinOS and provide creators with useful free resources that bring users back to the platform.

NOT a book piracy library. Only these resource types:
- Creator Guides
- Hook Collections
- Prompt Packs
- Swipe Files
- Marketing Templates
- Content Calendars
- AI Resources
- Checklists
- Frameworks

V1 FEATURES:

Admin:
- Upload PDF
- Title
- Description
- Cover Image
- Category
- Featured Toggle

User:
- Resource Vault Page
- Search Resources
- Category Filter
- Download/Open Resource

Categories:
- Content Creation
- Marketing
- AI Tools
- Growth
- Personal Branding
- Productivity
- Templates

DO NOT BUILD:
- Ratings, Comments, Likes, Reviews, Collections, Social Features, Complex Permissions, Analytics Dashboard

SUCCESS METRIC:
- 10 Resources Uploaded
- 100 Resource Downloads
- Increase Time On Site
- More Returning Users

PURPOSE: RobinOS becomes a creator operating system, not just a tool.

The app is React + Vite + TypeScript using Supabase (database + storage), shadcn/ui components, react-router-dom routing, tanstack/react-query for data fetching, Tailwind CSS for styling.

goal.answer: Build a Creator Resource Vault that lets admins upload curated PDF resources (guides, templates, frameworks, etc.) and lets users browse, search, filter by category, and download them. The vault replaces the existing `/resources` links hub and lives at `/resources`. Downloads require a free RobinOS account. This increases perceived platform value and drives returning traffic.

criteria.answer:
Database migration `47_resource_vault.sql` creates `public.resources` table with columns: id, title, description, category, file_path, cover_image_path, featured, download_count, created_at, updated_at, created_by
Supabase Storage `resources` bucket exists with public read policy and admin-only write policy
Admin panel at `/adminsh/resources` supports: list resources, create with PDF + cover image upload, edit metadata, delete resource
Public vault at `/resources` shows resource cards in a grid with cover image, title, category badge, and featured highlighting
Public vault supports live search by title/description and category filter
Clicking Download on a resource opens the PDF; unauthenticated users are prompted to log in; authenticated downloads increment `download_count`
TypeScript compiles without errors (`npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0)
No new ESLint errors introduced

phases.answer: Database & Storage Infrastructure, Admin Resource Management, Public Resource Vault & Integration

phaseSnapshots.name: Database & Storage Infrastructure
phaseSnapshots.goal: Create the database table and storage bucket needed to persist resources
phaseSnapshots.description: Write a Supabase migration that creates the `resources` table with all required columns, adds indexes for search/category queries, creates the `resources` storage bucket, and sets RLS policies so public can read and only admins can write. Also add TypeScript types for the new table.

steps.description: Write migration `supabase/migrations/47_resource_vault.sql`: create `resources` table, indexes, storage bucket, RLS policies

verification.command: grep -q 'create table public.resources' supabase/migrations/47_resource_vault.sql && grep -q 'resources' supabase/migrations/47_resource_vault.sql

steps.description: Run TypeScript check to ensure no type errors from new types

verification.command: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS' | xargs -I {} test {} -eq 0

phaseSnapshots.name: Admin Resource Management
phaseSnapshots.goal: Build the admin interface for uploading, editing, listing, and deleting resources
phaseSnapshots.description: Add `/adminsh/resources` route to App.tsx and AdminDashboard. Add 'Resources' sidebar item. Build inline admin page in AdminDashboard.tsx with a resource list table, create/edit modal form (zod + react-hook-form), file upload to Supabase Storage, and delete with confirmation.

steps.description: Add 'Resources' nav item to AdminDashboard sidebar and pageMeta
Implement `renderResourcesPage()` in AdminDashboard with list table, create/edit modal, Supabase Storage upload, and delete
Build resource form with zod validation, cover image preview, PDF upload progress
Wire up tanstack mutations for create, update, delete with toast notifications

phaseSnapshots.name: Public Resource Vault & Integration
phaseSnapshots.goal: Replace the existing `/resources` page with the new vault and integrate download gating
phaseSnapshots.description: Create `src/pages/ResourceVaultPage.tsx` with a public grid of resource cards, live search input, category filter buttons/dropdown, featured section at top, and download button that checks auth. Replace the old `/resources` route in App.tsx. Wire download to increment `download_count`.

steps.description: Create `src/pages/ResourceVaultPage.tsx` with grid layout, search, category filter, featured highlight
Update App.tsx to use ResourceVaultPage for `/resources` instead of old PublicInfoPages ResourcesPage
Implement download handler: check auth, redirect to login if needed, open PDF, increment download_count
Add react-query hook `useResources` with search + category filtering
Run build to ensure everything compiles and bundles

assumptions.answer: Supabase CLI/database migrations are the correct deployment path for schema changes; Cover images and PDFs stored in the same `resources` bucket with path prefixes (`covers/`, `pdfs/`); Old `/resources` links hub is safe to remove entirely because `/docs`, `/help`, `/status`, `/contact`, `/creator-guide`, `/affiliate-guide` all have their own dedicated routes; Admin users have `super_admin`, `admin`, or `support` role as checked by existing `get_admin_role()`; Download count incremented via simple Supabase `update` call on the client side (not transactional RPC) is acceptable for V1; Featured resources are visually prioritized at the top of the vault grid

payload.finalSummary: Creator Resource Vault V1 is complete. The feature includes: (1) Supabase database migration with resources table, indexes, RLS policies, and two storage buckets (resource-pdfs, resource-covers), (2) Admin panel at /adminsh/resources with full CRUD for resources including PDF/cover upload, slug management, featured toggle, and delete, (3) Public Resource Vault at /resources with a responsive grid, search, category filters, featured highlight, and resource detail pages at /resources/:slug, (4) Auth-gated downloads that redirect to login for unauthenticated users and increment download_count for authenticated users, (5) TypeScript compiles cleanly and the production build succeeds.
